In case of bunch bids, the primary product having highest value should meet this criterion. 5. Generic Malicious Code Certificate:

Non-Disclosure Declaration cert ECS Mandate duly certified by bank Registration Cert 1. Bidder Eligibility & Relevant Experience 1. Bidder shall have successfully completed minimum 2 similar specialized technical training assignments during the last 3 financial years in the relevant domain. 2. Generic IT/computer training shall not be considered equivalent to specialized domain training. 3. Bidder shall submit relevant Work Order/PO and Completion/Performance Certificate as documentary proof. 4. Bidder shall have an average annual turnover of minimum ₹25 lakh during the last 3 completed financial years. 5. Training shall be delivered by qualified Subject Matter Experts having minimum 5 years relevant domai n experience. Trainer CV shall be submitted. 6. Minimum 40% of the training duration shall involve practical laboratory exercises, demonstrations, assignments, case studies and hands-on assessment. 7. Bidder shall possess or have authorized access to the required specialized hardware, software, laboratory infrastructure and tools relevant to the course. 8. For Mobile Network Security/SDR training, bidder shall demonstrate capability in 2G/3G/4G/5G security, SDR-based testing, cellular testbeds, protocol/signaling analysis and authorized SIM/USIM laboratory environments. 9. For Drone Forensics training, bidder shall demonstrate capability in DJI flight-log acquisition/analysis, telemetry analysis, drone evidence handling, forensic reconstruction and technical reporting. 10. Buyer may conduct a technical demonstration/evaluation prior to award to verify the bidder's pra ctical capability and availability of required infrastructure. 11. Bidder shall provide training material, practical assignments, assessment and individual course completion certificates. 12. All practical activities involving RF, cellular networks, drones or digital evidence shall be conducted only in authorized, controlled and legally compliant environments. . 10. Generic Actual delivery (and Installation & Commissioning (if covered in scope of supply)) is to be done at following address Mr David Hussain 18 EW Bn Oppisite R center Leh & Ladhakh (J & K) Mobile number 8158071341 Pin number 194101 .
